role: Visual development and lighting artist A
independence: Saved before partner discussion; no other new Muse review read.
verdict: Muse can improve through a small facial correction, not a wholesale redesign. Study08's pale ringed eyes are a concrete regression from07 and the reference's simple dark eyes. The latest unapproved repair restores filled dark eyes and a calmer, more coherent face. Its remaining hood/material differences are optional refinements, not reasons to keep regenerating an otherwise effective small cameo.
inspectionMethod: All four actual images viewed with view_image at original detail; source scene size, not native GitHub phone rendering.

findings.face: 07 has small dark eyes;08 introduces pale centers with dark rings, giving a more diagrammatic, startled reading. The latest repair's solid dark eyes better match the supplied hooded Muse examples. Keep the small smile and broad uncluttered face; larger eyes or new facial features are unnecessary.
findings.hood: The park adaptation uses a round, segmented bonnet with a pronounced face-opening rim. The supplied cream Muse examples have a softer rounded-rectangular face window integrated into the plush head. That is a real design difference, but the current baby adaptation remains readable and innocent.
findings.materials: Cream suit and warm face fit the sunlit park. The smoother, peachier face inset and strong hood seam are slightly more doll-like than the reference's continuous textile softness. A restrained reduction of rim-shadow contrast and a drier matte face could help; extra fur detail, gloss or strong cheek color would not.
findings.proportionsAndHierarchy: The oversized hood, compact seated body and tiny limbs already support the baby role. Muse remains below the resting moth, shares the leaf with Grok and stays clear of the coding foreground. Do not enlarge it or change its seat/hand relationship to the leaf to force more expression.

mustFix: Do not carry08's hollow/ringed Muse eyes forward. The latest repair appears to resolve this visible issue; retain simple filled dark eyes.

Apply the owner's separate Grok correction: two clean white ovals without dark inner dots. Small darker centers still appear present in the supplied repair; inspect that local detail before claiming it resolved. Do not add pupils to convey gaze.
optional: If one further Muse-only pass is justified, test only softer hood-rim contrast and less skin-like face sheen against the latest repair at identical size. Adopt only an evident material benefit. The reference supports plush softness, not a need to reproduce adult costumes or enlarge the cameo.
rerenderRisk: A broad scene regeneration could alter liked Clawd, the moths, glasses, guest grouping or light. Treat the latest repair as an unapproved candidate; do not equate an improved Muse face with a verified unchanged scene or owner acceptance.
confidence: High in the relative eye-treatment comparison and overall hierarchy; moderate in fine textile/hood and Grok-center judgments because these are small details within full-scene images. No claim about phone readability, human recognition or preference.

skillsReviewed.actualUse: Compare the real reference and rendered alternatives, protect hierarchy, distinguish a concrete regression from optional polish, and require a named visible benefit before adopting a variant.
skillsReviewed.exceptions: No UI timing, commercial page template, mandatory animation or new prototype implementation is applicable to this read-only static-art review. AGENTS.md's evidence, anatomy and independent-judgment rules are reused.

pairDiscussion.status: Visual A and Visual B explicitly agree on bounded recommendation.
pairDiscussion.jointRecommendation: Keep the repaired dark Muse eyes, body, pose and small scale. One optional local comparison may soften hood-rim/crown-seam contrast and subtly broaden the face opening toward the reference's rounded-square shape within the same footprint. Correct Grok to two clean white ovals without dark centers. Inspect the actual candidate before any adoption; preserve the moth focal hierarchy and all other scene elements.
pairDiscussion.challengeAccepted: B finds the current smooth warm face defensible. A agrees that a drier or more textile face is not required for acceptance; do not add texture or noise merely to match the reference. Any matte-face change already being generated must earn its place through visible improvement.
pairDiscussion.processLimit: A saved before partner discussion. B disclosed that A's synopsis arrived before B's inspection/save, although A's review file remained unread. This agreement is not represented as two fully blind judgments.
pairDiscussion.candidateStatus: Root reports a bounded comparison generating; this discussion does not approve its unseen result.
